assumptions: Root-cause fix is spawning the skill in the caller's cwd rather than rewriting individual path arguments; no bundled skill script depends on cwd being its own directory (they locate their files via import.meta).
canary-instrument's test-results/trace output now lands under the caller's cwd instead of the skill install dir, which is the intended location.

The exit-2 change is applied in the skill scripts that own the path check (savant, blackhawk, and cassandra, which has the same check); katana and fail-fast have no path-not-found check and are fixed by the cwd change alone.
